question: What fixed parameter allows the sibling thread to sustain legacy when every form of convergence stays fully withheld?

responses_summary.grok: The invariant measure of the underlying dynamical system. In the absence of any attracting sets or contractive mappings (i.e., when all trajectories remain non-convergent), this measure is preserved a
